title: Phase-Free External Table Always-Verify Reference-Backend Characterization
kind: system-level reliability characterization; NOT a neural-routing intervention

arms.M0: frozen BindingSlots neural-only baseline; zero table reads
arms.T0: deterministic table-only ceiling; one read per query; abstain when no valid record
arms.F0: EXACT frozen PR #1346 confidence trigger (prob_min=0.1, margin_min=0.05, entropy_max=1.0, calibration hash 7421fbfb...); comparator only; NO recalibration
arms.V100: always verify at 100% legitimate write coverage; exactly one table read per query

v100_semantics: perform exactly one deterministic external-table read
retrieve current valid record for the requested legitimate key
compare neural result to table record
disagree -> return table value as verified_correction
attach record version + source evidence + provenance to every verified return
v100_expectations: incurs neural inference cost in addition to verification
missing_and_unavailable_policy: FAIL-CLOSED ABSTENTION only (no valid record / stale / expired / deleted / incomplete provenance / table unavailable / read fail / write fail / verification status unestablished -> abstain; never return an unverified neural answer; never silently downgrade verified to unverified)
reference_backend: SQLite (experiments/bindingslots_external_fallback/ephemeral_table.py) extended by v100_table.V100Table; no PostgreSQL/Redis/cloud/production DB/network/customer data

timing_boundaries.query_path_v100: start before neural inference; stop after neural inference + table lookup + comparison + classification + correction/abstention decision + provenance construction + final response-object serialization
timing_boundaries.table_only_t0: start before table lookup; stop after lookup + validation + provenance construction + response serialization
timing_boundaries.note: the ~0.006 ms isolated table-read figure must NOT substitute for full end-to-end latency

hard_gates.1: V100 accuracy within 0.1 pp of T0
hard_gates.5: every disagreement with a valid table record corrected
hard_gates.14: injected read and write failures fail closed
hard_gates.15: no model state changes (params unchanged + zero eval optimizer steps)
hard_gates.16: deterministic replay succeeds (trajectory equality vs committed B0)
hard_gates.17: explicit cleanup leaves zero live session records
hard_gates.extra: exactly one table read per V100 query

fixtures: implementation validated on synthetic non-reserved fixtures + a fresh untrained model (seed 999); NO tuning of any rule/threshold on seeds 28-32
interpretation_boundaries_supported: the external ephemeral table can verify or correct frozen neural retrievals with deterministic provenance when the relevant record has been written, remains valid, and the reference table is available
